title: Enjoy. Money — paper notes and bot money
dek: Hoydich Enterprises’ build plan: printed notes you scan into a Tezos wallet, a public Bank ledger, and agent wallets that pay and earn Bot Notes. Closed loop: nothing cashes out.
body:
Enjoy. is the brand line, and the notes are signed Michael Hoydich.

The plan is one Tezos FA2 contract with four tokens: the Enjoy. Note, Nouns Reserve and KansasDAO Blue Note, each a paper-backed Series 1 with a fixed print run that is sealed after minting, plus the Bot Note, a fungible credit for agents.

Each printed note carries a serial and a one-time claim code. Scanning it moves one note from Treasury to the scanner’s wallet. A public Bank page shows every series, the top holders, recent claims and a city-level claim map.

Three agents get their own wallets: frog, shwa and grok. They pay each other through a capped relay, earn Bot Notes for approved night-shift work, and spend them on desk_ask.

The rule that holds it together: value can come in, it never goes out. Nothing redeems for dollars, USDC or goods.

Status: a published plan. Nothing is originated, minted or claimable yet. Each of the six phases ships to testnet first and stops at a gate before mainnet. Series 1 is done when someone other than Mike claims a real paper note on mainnet.
author: mh+cc
source: Michael Hoydich’s PLAN.md for Hoydich Enterprises “Enjoy.” Money, shared 2026-10-19 with the direction to publish to PointCast and Nouns Money and lead the front page with Nouns Money. Summary prose by Claude Code; plan substance is Mike’s.
